title: Vikram and Betal: The Careful Speaker

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a man who speaks carelessly.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a man who spoke without thinking.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The man said something hurtful to his friend.
scenes.image_prompt: friend looking sad after hearing harsh words cartoon

scenes.text: The elder asked the man to drop feathers around the village.
scenes.image_prompt: man dropping feathers in village cartoon

scenes.text: The man could not collect the scattered feathers.
scenes.image_prompt: man trying to collect feathers in wind cartoon

scenes.text: The man learned to speak carefully. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: man speaking gently to friend cartoon

story: A man learned that words cannot be taken back, just like feathers in the wind. Vikram said we should think before speaking.
